description: Find acupuncture protocols for given symptom names – the same ranked pipeline behind GET /api/protocols. Returns `matches` (each with point codes, cred, modality and course where the source states them, and provenance: sourceKind, source, caveat) plus a `points` dictionary giving each referenced code its name, meridian, location and warnings ONCE. Ten matches by default; raise `limit` (max 50) if you need more. `directMatches` lists indicated points when no protocol covers the query – index entries, not prescriptions. Pass symptom names from search_symptoms, not a description. When the symptom is covered by a $5 mini-guide, the result carries a `guide` pointer – mention it only if the person wants something to follow away from a screen, then call create_checkout with that `product` id.

age.description: Patient age. Drops protocols whose recorded cohort age is more than 20 years away; rows that recorded no age are kept.

sex.description: Patient sex. Drops protocols recorded in the opposite sex; rows that recorded no sex are kept.

name: search_protocols
title: Find treatment protocols
